data: Insert and delete rows and columns
Make room in a sheet and drag a selection from the toolbar.

Insert rows, insert columns, or delete either. Open Rows and Columns in the sheet menu or look up the command in the palette. Formulas and linked sources follow the cells that move. Undo restores the data and its links. Rows and columns guide.

Drag a selection from the export icon. It sits beside the sheet name. Drag it to share the selection, or click it to save a CSV. Export guide.

The desktop check confirmed the CSV save dialog. The attempted drops into Finder and TextEdit did not land. Physical 120 Hz timing remains open because the test Mac had a 60 Hz display.
